To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) NSAIDs are a group of drugs that are widely used for their anti-inflammatory, analgesic and antipyretic properties, (2) the mechanism of action is inhibition of prostaglandin biosynthesis, (3) the most common adverse effects are gastrointestinal, renal and skin, (4) the most important drug interaction is that with aspirin and (5) NSAIDs are the most widely used group of drugs in the world.
